feeds.title: Sarah Jacquelyn Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Sarah Jacquelyn Interiors creates conceived spaces that can positively impact lives and reflect the identity and lifestyle of the people who live there. They specialize in blending contemporary design with eclectic accents to create beautifully layered, functional interiors. Their blog features basic design ideas, tips, and a guide to creating your dream home.

feeds.title: Paula Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Paula Interiors is a boutique firm that helps in designing, furnishing, and decorating your kitchen, bathroom, living room, bedroom, or office to create spaces that are inviting. They bring you the best color interior design ideas and tips for every room in your home. Their blog helps you transform your spaces with designs that balance out textures from the floors to the ceilings.

feeds.title: Kuchar Studio
feeds.description: Kuchar is a boutique interior design studio that strives to find new ways of creating unique solutions for everyone through interior design, interior styling, furniture design, research, and procurement. Kuchar designs home, office, multi-family, and hospitality interiors. To learn more about their work and interior design world follow their informative blog.

feeds.title: Drury Design Blog
feeds.description: Drury Design is an award-winning remodeling firm specializing in custom kitchens and baths in the Chicago area. Their talented professional designers create exceptionally personalized spaces for you. From expert planning to installation and project management services, Drury Design ensures each remodeling project exceeds expectations and is completed on schedule.

feeds.title: Centered by Design
feeds.description: Centered by Design is Chicago's best full-service residential interior design studio. Their blog features articles on topics related to interior design and home-related subjects. They offer design inspiration, latest ideas, and trends to help you discover new possibilities for your home decor.

feeds.title: Kenneth Walter Blog
feeds.description: Kenneth Walter can do in-person consults throughout Illinois and is available by Zoom nationwide. He creates environments that are healing, soulful and handsome. Kenneth is an expert at his craft and is devoted to providing real-life solutions for fine living, partnering with his life-long clients to create smart and savvy solutions tailored to meet their unique standard of living. He also shares design tips, ideas, and inspirations in his blog.

feeds.title: Devon Grace Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Devon Grace Interiors create functional, bespoke spaces, with innovation that helps us in streamlining the design process with cutting-edge technology and a holistic approach to reimagining spaces. The founders, Devon and Michael Wegman specialize in luxury residential and commercial design. Head to their blog to learn more about their work, their services, latest designs and more.

feeds.title: Michelle's Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Michelle's Interiors believe that your home should make you feel as if you are on vacation, every day. It should be your favorite getaway, a place where you can refresh and rejuvenate. They design the surroundings that are the backdrop of your life and we use sustainable, eco-conscious materials for a healthier home. Their blog features one-of-a-kind homes that they designed over the past three decades.

feeds.title: Outline Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Outline Interiors is a full-service luxury interior design firm specializing in full-scale renovations, end-to-end home furnishings, and single and multi-family commercial developments. They create a cohesive, functional, and distinguished design that is executed on time and on budget. Laura Tribbett, the owner and principal designer of Outline Interiors shares stories about commercial and residential projects in her blog.

feeds.title: Ayres Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Ayres Interiors Blog is an informative blog that focuses on interior design and home decor. It's all about making your living spaces beautiful and cozy! The blog shares lots of helpful tips, from choosing colors and furniture to following the latest design trends.

feeds.title: Veronica Ferro Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Founded by Principal Designer Veronica Ferro in 2014, we are the preferred designer among busy professionals who want their homes to be as unique as they are. For home makeover tips and choosing what's right for your home read their blog.

feeds.title: Alluring Designs Chicago Blog
feeds.description: Alluring Designs Chicago is an interior design firm offering design services for residential and commercial spaces. Read Alluring Designs Chicago's blog to know about budget design, seasonal decor, tips, and a lot more.

feeds.title: Park and Oak Interior Design
feeds.description: Founded by Christina Samatas and Renee DiSanto in 2015, Park and Oak Interior Design are known for creating homes that are visually stunning, yet functional and comfortable looking. Using beautiful and unexpected sources of inspiration, they work collaboratively with clients to create spaces that thoughtfully honor the spirit and traditions. Read their blog to get information about their work, past projects, latest interior designs, industry trends and more.

feeds.title: Atchison Architectural Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Atchison Architectural Interiors designs classic and timeless spaces infused with a chic modern vibe. By merging traditional and contemporary elements, the team creates fresh, sophisticated looks. Their interiors are elegantly balanced, carefully edited, and current with a thoughtful mix of furnishings, textures, finishes, and objects. Follow their blog to read articles on the latest designs, industry trends, past projects, news and more.

feeds.title: Tina Dann-Fenwick Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Tina Dann-Fenwick Interiors Blog offers ideas and solutions that will enable you to realize a vision beyond your expectations. Follow them for the latest style and design tips for your home.

feeds.title: Studio Brunstrum Blog
feeds.description: Creating a home and commercial environment where you can experience the life that you imagined. Susan Brunstrum, the founder believes in creating comfortable and happy spaces by incorporating color, pattern, architectural details, and shapes that enable you to live the life that you imagined. Embrace both the classic and the unexpected to compose a cultivated environment, their blog invites you to explore the pieces that make you whole.

feeds.title: Claudia Martin Design Blog
feeds.description: Claudia Martin Design is a full-service luxury interior design firm specializing in residential new construction and full-scale renovations of residential and multi-family residential spaces. Their blogs help you get professional guidance and also let you implement the project on your own.

feeds.title: Amy Kartheiser Design Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2014, Amy Kartheiser Design creates designs that ignite the imagination with a layered mix of modern, traditional, and global elements that offer a sense of elegance and ease. The company believes in maintaining a balance between elegance and ease, seamlessly blending traditional elements, modern touches, and global influences. Head to their blog to learn more about the latest designed, trends, and news form the industry along with their past projects.
